Subject: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — timezone coverage options

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for continuing the conversation around ClearMed's renewal. We want to make the QBR + roadmap demo as frictionless as possible for your global team. Two quick scheduling options that would work on our side: 

1) Daytime EMEA slot: Tue May 12, 10:00–11:00 CET — standard live demo with product + solutions owner present.
2) Overnight APAC-friendly slot: Wed May 13, 01:00–02:00 CET (evening PT) — condensed demo with a dedicated recording and a live regional handoff so APAC stakeholders can join asynchronously.

If neither works, we can run the demo twice (short live + recorded deep-dive) but would like to avoid duplicating presenters. Can you share which stakeholders need to attend (execs vs tech vs procurement) and their timezones?

I'll loop Marissa on ops/runbook and include a backup host in case of conflicts. Attached is a draft runbook and the current slide deck for context.

Best,
Diego Fernandez

- Tom (VP Product, CET)
- Priya (Head of Clinical Ops, IST)
- Luke (Procurement, ET)

Could we prioritize a CET morning slot and record a focused APAC walkthrough for Priya? If so, please propose a run-of-show that minimizes duplicate content for the recorded version.

Thanks Sarah — happy to adapt. Proposal below to balance live engagement and a recorded APAC walkthrough: 

Proposed run-of-show (live CET session):
- 10:00–10:05 CET: Quick exec intro (Tom + Sarah)
- 10:05–10:20 CET: Product highlights and recent latency / cost benchmarks (Diego)
- 10:20–10:35 CET: Roadmap deep-dive (Marissa)
- 10:35–10:50 CET: Integration & rollout Q&A (technical SME to join if specific questions)
- 10:50–11:00 CET: Next steps + action items (confirm procurement handoff)

APAC recorded supplement (ASAP after live):
- Condensed 20–25 minute recorded walkthrough targeted at Priya (clinical use-cases, privacy controls, and private-deploy options).
- Include a 5 min annotated transcript of the demo sections to make the recording skimmable.

Ops notes / backups:
- Backup host: Marissa Cole (slides + recording owner)
- Alternate presenter: Gia (Solutions Engineer) — on standby if the tech SME can't make it.
- Runbook checklist attached: final pre-call test, recording settings, timezone calendar invites (I updated QBR_runbook_v2.pdf with a one-page checklist).

I can prep the skimmable transcript and the short recorded segment right after the live session so Priya gets it same day. Diego — can you confirm Tom's availability for Tue May 12 or Wed May 13 10:00 CET? I'll draft the calendar invite and include the recording link + summary.

Best,
